name: Chromolaena
look_here_first: Inspect one individual capitulum sideways: a cylindrical 8–10 mm involucre with 4–6 or more phyllary series, versus rounded shorter Conoclinium heads. Confirm opposite toothed three-veined leaves and branching shrubby habit.
shared_genus_traits: Usually opposite, toothed leaves with 3 basal main veins
Rayless capitula in branching clusters; overlapping imbricate phyllaries

lookalike_genus_comparisons.difference: Individual heads shorter and more hemispherical, fewer series of phyllaries; Gregg's cut leaves especially distinctive
A. havanensis white heads shorter involucres and different phyllaries; often woody; A. altissima herbaceous

lookalike_genus_comparisons.canonical_status: fleischmannia-incarnata canonical and 4 real photographs installed on 2026-10-13; specialty bract macros pending
lookalike_genus_comparisons.difference: Pink thoroughwort overlaps in pink-to-lilac flower color and opposite toothed leaves. Compare ONE capitulum from the side: Fleischmannia short ~4–5 mm involucre with fewer phyllary series versus Chromolaena odorata generally elongated cylindrical ~8–10 mm involucre with numerous imbricate phyllary ranks. Fleischmannia is usually a lax/scandent herb; Chromolaena more robust shrub-like. Do not separate solely by color or leaf shape.
photo_requirements: same-scale lateral capitulum views with arrows on bract series and mm ruler
mature leaf and stem habit comparison

diagnostic_photo_checklist.shot: single head side showing cylindrical overlapping bracts
